USER.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_user(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,name TEXT,password TEXT, username TEXT UNIQUE,mobile TEXT, role TEXT, active INTEGER, image TEXT, created_by TEXT,created_date TEXT)
USER.SELECT_USER_NAME_PASS: SELECT id, name, role, password FROM <>_user WHERE username = ?
USER.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_user (name, password, username, mobile, role, active, image, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, ?, ?,?,?,?, DATE('now'))
USER.SELECT_USER_BY_ROLE: select id,name,role,mobile from <>_user where role = ? and active = 1

LEAD.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_lead(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT UNIQUE,company_name TEXT, city TEXT,state TEXT, contact_number TEXT, enquiry_type TEXT, email TEXT, requirement TEXT, progress TEXT, stage TEXT, next_followup TEXT, status TEXT, assigned_to Integer, assigned_by Integer, active INTEGER, created_by TEXT,created_date TEXT)
LEAD.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_lead(name ,company_name, city, state, contact_number, enquiry_type, email, requirement, progress, stage, next_followup, status, assigned_to, assigned_by, active, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?, ?,?,?, ?, ?, DATE('now'))
LEAD.SELECT_BY_LEADID: select * from <>_lead where id = ? and active = 1

PROJECT.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_project(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, lead_id INTEGER, stage TEXT, next_followup TEXT, status TEXT, assigned_to Integer, assigned_by Integer, active INTEGER, created_by TEXT,created_date TEXT)
PROJECT.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_project(lead_id, stage, next_followup, status, assigned_to, assigned_by, active, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?, ?,?, 1, 1, DATE('now'))

LEAD_TIMELINE.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_leadtimline(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, lead_id INTEGER, message TEXT, docs_urls TEXT, created_by TEXT,created_date TEXT)
LEAD_TIMELINE.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_leadtimline(lead_id, message, docs_urls, status, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, 1, 1, DATE('now'))

PROJECT_TIMELINE.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_projecttimline(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, project_id INTEGER, message TEXT, docs_urls TEXT, created_by TEXT,created_date TEXT)
PROJECT_TIMELINE.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_projecttimline(project_id, message, docs_urls, status, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, 1, 1, DATE('now'))

ROLE.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_role(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,name TEXT UNIQUE)

COMPANY.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,name TEXT UNIQUE, aliasname TEXT, active INTEGER, created_date TEXT)
COMPANY.INSERT: INSERT INTO company (name, aliasname, active, created_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?, DATE('now'))
COMPANY.SELECT_COMPANY_NAME: SELECT name FROM company WHERE name = ?
COMPANY.SELECT_COMPANY_ALIASNAME: SELECT name FROM company WHERE aliasname = ?
